en: Theragāthā 1.89 Ekakanipāta Navamavagga (The Ninth Chapter) I am alone, O King, dwelling in the forest; I have no companion here, nor do I have anyone to converse with. I dwell alone, O King, in the forest, having abandoned all attachments. I am one who has transcended all bonds and crossed over the flood. I am one who has attained peace and is free from fear. I am one who has reached the further shore and stands upon dry land. I am one who has realized Nibbāna and is cooled. I am one who has laid down the heavy burden and is liberated. I am one who has done what was to be done and has no more existence. I am one who has cut off the stream and is without craving. I am one who has destroyed the conceit "I am" and is without grasping. I am one who has attained the state of an Arhat and is worthy of offerings. I am one who has reached the goal and is secure. I am one who has attained the supreme security from bondage. I am one who has reached the end of suffering. I am one who has crossed over the ocean of existence. I am one who has reached the island of safety. I am one who has attained the deathless. I am one who has reached the ultimate refuge. I am one who has attained the supreme bliss. I am one who has reached the end of the world. I am one who has attained the cessation of suffering. I am one who has realized the Dhamma. I am one who has seen the Truth. I am one who has attained the vision of the Dhamma. I am one who has reached the state of a Buddha’s disciple. I am one who has attained the fruit of the path. I am one who has realized the goal of the holy life. I am one who has attained the state of a sage. I am one who has reached the state of a victor.

I am one who has attained the state of a conqueror. I am one who has reached the state of a hero. I am one who has attained the state of a steadfast one. I am one who has reached the state of a noble one. I am one who has attained the state of a purified one. I am one who has reached the state of a stainless one. I am one who has attained the state of a non-feeling one. I am one who has reached the state of a non-craving one. I am one
